title: Newspaper Employees Conditions of Service Amendment Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: Newspaper Employees Conditions of Service Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT LVI OF 1975
ACT LVI OF 1975
NEWSPAPER
EMPLOYEES (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act to amend
the Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service)
Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the News paper Employees
(Conditions of Service) (Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

The following Act of Parliament

2. Amendment of section 2, Act
LVIII of 1973.-In the Newspaper Employees, (Conditions of Service) Act,
1973 (LVIII of 1973), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section, 2,
after clause (g), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:-
"(gg) `Tribunal' means a
Tribunal constituted under section 12-A;".

sections.shortTitle: Newspaper Employees Conditions of Service Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 12-A, Act LVIII of 1973

ACT LVI OF 1975
ACT LVI OF 1975
NEWSPAPER
EMPLOYEES (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act to amend
the Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service)
Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
3. Insertion of new section
12-A, Act LVIII of 1973.-In the said Act, after section 12, the following
new section 12-A shall be inserted, namely:-
"12-A. Tribunal.--(1) The
Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, constitute a
Tribunal consisting of one member to imple ment the decision of the Board under
section 11.
(2) The member of the Tribunal
shall be a person who is or has been or is qualified to be a Judge of a High
Court and shall be appointed on such terms and conditions as the Federal
Government may determine.".

4. Amendment of section 13,
Act LVIII of 1973.----In the said Act, is section 13,-
(a) in subsection (1), for the word "Commission"
the word "Tribunal" shall be substituted
(b) in subsection (3),-
(i) for the word
"Commission" the word "Tribunal" shall be substituted; and
(ii) for the word "it"
the words "the Commission" shall be substituted; and
(c) after subsection (3), the
following new subsection shall be added, namely:-
"(3-A) The Tribunal shall
have the power to issue a direction which a Labour Court has under subsection
(1) of section 51 of the Ordinance.".

5. Insertion of section 13-A,
Act LVIII of 1973.-In the said Act, after section 13 amended as aforesaid,
the following new section shall be inserted, namely:-
"13-A.
Appeal from sentence of Tribunal.-Any person convicted and sentenced by the
Tribunal under section 55 of the Ordinance to imprisonment for any period not
less than six months may, with the leave of the Supreme Court, prefer an appeal
to that Court.".
